messages:
maria: Hey folks — PTAL at PR #8462: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/8462. I pushed a follow-up that addresses the comments from earlier, fixed a squash conflict, and added a tiny smoke test for routing. CI is green except I quarantined a flaky `request-rate-limit.test` (see CI note). Canaries planned for tomorrow 10:00am PST — need one approver and for merge-ops to queue it. Thanks!

ajay: grabbing this now, will run the smoke locally and leave any nits.

ci-bot: build #2467 — checks: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e ✅ (quarantined: request-rate-limit.test). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/2467

lina: quick q — did you inadvertently change the default batch size? we saw perf shifts last week.

maria: @lina no change to default batching. Only change is the kvcache allocator tweak and the new smoke test. Diff summary: ```
- src/serving/kv_allocator.rs: small bounds check fix
- tests/smoke/routing_smoke.py: added basic request payloads
```

ajay: smoke run was clean for me locally. left one tiny nit inline about a log level, not blocking. ptal @lina @sam

sam: skimmed — looks good. one log wording nit (INFO -> DEBUG) and then i'll approve.

maria: pushed fix for the log level and rebased to resolve the conflict. @ops-bot can you queue for merge during the morning canary window? tag: merge-broker

ops-bot: Merge queue entry created by maria for PR #8462 — scheduled for 2024-06-11 18:00 UTC. :hourglass: (you can bump/cancel with `/merge-ops edit 8462`)

ajay: approved ✅

maria: awesome — thanks both. i'll watch the canary and will roll back if anything pops. ping me if you'd like to hand off monitoring.

Note: I quarantined the flaky test so CI passing is intentional; filing a follow-up issue to unflake: https://git.redwood/issues/FLAKE-302
